sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic survey only (fieldwork Aug 2005, Seoni district MP). p.4: 'The researchers attempted to collect Nagarchi wordlists in many areas, but this was not possible because the people no longer speak Nagarchi. Even elderly Nagarchi people were not able to provide wordlists in the Nagarchi language.' Conclusion: Nagarchal is not a viable language; the community has shifted to Gondi and Hindi. No linguistic data of any kind.
